{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Copilot Setup Steps

# Runs before the Copilot cloud agent starts to prepare its ephemeral environment. In addition
# to installing PHP, Composer, and npm (and running Boost via the post-autoload-dump hook), this
# provisions Postgres and Redis services and prepares landlord/tenant testing databases so the
# agent can execute the app's commands, tests, linting, and formatters.
on: # zizmor: ignore[concurrency-limits]
    workflow_dispatch:
    push:
        paths:
            - .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml
    pull_request:
        paths:
            - .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml

permissions: {}

jobs:
    # The job MUST be named `copilot-setup-steps` or Copilot will not pick it up.
    copilot-setup-steps:
        name: Copilot Setup Steps
        runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

        permissions:
            contents: read

        timeout-minutes: 20

        concurrency:
            group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
            cancel-in-progress: true

        env:
            php-extensions: gd, gmp, redis, mailparse
            php-extensions-key: ext-cache-copilot-v1
            php-version: '8.4'
            DB_PORT: 5432
            DB_HOST: 127.0.0.1
            DB_USERNAME: root
            DB_PASSWORD: root
            DB_DATABASE: testing_landlord
            REDIS_HOST: 127.0.0.1
            REDIS_PORT: '7000'

        services:
            postgres:
                image: postgres:15@sha256:6eb0add3b77c081df18aa518ce43df58fdcc40f2e6d868a6fd08038dc7acd425
                ports:
                    - 5432:5432
                env:
                    POSTGRES_DB: testing_landlord
                    POSTGRES_USER: root
                    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: root
                options: >-
                    --health-cmd pg_isready
                    --health-interval 10s
                    --health-timeout 5s
                    --health-retries 5

        steps:
            # A real 3-master cluster (ports 7000-7002) matching the cluster-mode ElastiCache Serverless used in staging and production.
            - name: Start Redis (3-master cluster)
              run: |
                  docker run -d --name redis --network host \
                    redis:7.4.12@sha256:bd28fff4b665fdf1b73e8b5b73ec05d2f858f4fa3c8ea0d7c9bc09f7f6bf7039 \
                    sh -c '
                      for port in 7000 7001 7002; do
                        redis-server --daemonize yes --port "$port" --appendonly no --save "" \
                          --cluster-enabled yes --cluster-config-file "nodes-$port.conf" --cluster-node-timeout 5000
                      done
                      for port in 7000 7001 7002; do
                        until redis-cli -p "$port" ping | grep -q PONG; do sleep 1; done
                      done
                      redis-cli --cluster create 127.0.0.1:7000 127.0.0.1:7001 127.0.0.1:7002 --cluster-replicas 0 --cluster-yes
                      tail -f /dev/null
                    '

                  for port in 7000 7001 7002; do
                    until docker exec redis redis-cli -p "$port" cluster info | grep -q 'cluster_state:ok'; do sleep 1; done
                  done

            - name: Create tenant database
              run: psql -h 127.0.0.1 -d testing_landlord -U root -c 'CREATE DATABASE testing_tenant;'
              env:
                  PGPASSWORD: root

            - name: Setup cache environment
              id: extcache
              uses: shivammathur/cache-extensions@c33688ce81fd884ddd70d51cadeb62b6fb974750 #1.15.8
              with:
                  php-version: ${{ env.php-version }}
                  extensions: ${{ env.php-extensions }}
                  key: ${{ env.php-extensions-key }}

            - name: Cache extensions
              uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
              with:
                  path: ${{ steps.extcache.outputs.dir }}
                  key: ${{ runner.os }}-24.04-phpext-${{ env.php-version }}-${{ env.php-extensions-key }}
                  restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-24.04-phpext-${{ env.php-version }}

            - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962 #2.40.0
              with:
                  php-version: ${{ env.php-version }}
                  coverage: none
                  extensions: ${{ env.php-extensions }}

            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  fetch-depth: 0
                  fetch-tags: true
                  persist-credentials: false

            - name: Copy .env
              run: php -r "file_exists('.env') || copy('.env.example', '.env');"

            - name: Cache dependencies
              id: cache-composer
              uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
              with:
                  path: vendor
                  key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock', 'app-modules/**/composer.lock') }}

            - if: ${{ steps.cache-composer.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
              name: Install Dependencies
              run: composer install -q --no-ansi --no-interaction --no-scripts --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader
              shell: bash

            - name: Generate key
              run: php artisan key:generate

            # Fires the post-autoload-dump hook (common:publish + boost:update) which generates
            # AGENTS.md, .github/skills, and .ai/guidelines used by the agent.
            - name: Publish Boost instructions and skills
              run: composer dump-autoload

            - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
              with:
                  node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
                  cache: 'npm'

            - name: Install JavaScript dependencies
              run: npm install

            - name: Build Assets
              run: npm run build

            - name: Migrate Landlord Database
              run: php artisan migrate --database=landlord --path=database/landlord --force

            - name: Set up Tenant
              run: php artisan tenants:create test test.advisingapp.local -y

            - name: Generate Helper Files
              run: php artisan app:generate-helper-files",
  "rationale": "The workflow already caches dependencies (Composer vendor, PHP extensions, npm) and sets a job timeout, so the dependency-cache and custom-timeout patterns are already satisfied; adding another dependency cache would hit the 'equivalent cache already exists' contraindication. The supported, not-yet-applied optimization that fits is P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE: cancel superseded runs. This workflow triggers on push/pull_request to the workflow file, so repeated pushes to the same branch launch redundant Copilot setup runs and a newer revision supersedes the older one. Adding a per-ref concurrency group with cancel-in-progress stops the stale runner while the latest run completes the same setup, preserving every build/test step and coverage. No permissions are weakened, no secrets/publishing/deployment added, and no new network access introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
